attributes.stack: Eleventy (11ty) + Nunjucks + Tailwind v4 + GSAP + Sanity

attributes.rationale: Item 3 now routes to the vault-root goals/ folder — a sibling of the dataink.io/ directory — under Obsidian's Project Manager plugin, because goals migrated out of the repo. Task frontmatter is the source of truth and status: "in-progress" marks active work.

attributes.fast_path: single-file edit, template lookup, quick question — portfolio-frontend.md + copilot-instructions.md only
attributes.full_path: implementation, choreography, architecture, multi-file — all four orientation docs
attributes.rationale: Spend reads in cost order so trivial tasks do not pay the full orientation cost.

attributes.location: vault-root goals/ (../../goals/), a sibling of the dataink.io/ directory — NOT inside this repo
attributes.source_of_truth: task frontmatter; a project note's taskIds and ## Tasks checklist are plugin-generated and drift
attributes.removed_paths: frontend/context/current-goals.md and frontend/context/goals/ do not exist — removed when goals migrated to the vault root; do not recreate
attributes.rationale: Goals moved to Obsidian's Project Manager plugin at the vault root so a single dashboard spans all projects; never fork or restate goals into this repo — link to them. type: subtask entries are deliberately absent from the top-level checklist.

attributes.rules: page-level work starts at views/pages/<name>/<name>.njk; never infer source behavior from _site/ (but do read rendered _site/<page>.html to verify output); never hand-edit styles/colors.css or styles/typography/fontFamilies.css; never call Tailwind CLI directly; never bypass choreography lifecycle gating; never introduce new global singletons; CSS import order in styles/main.css is fonts → Tailwind → base → theme → components; templates live in views/, not njk/
attributes.rationale: The documented system is not the page — confirm real above-the-fold composition and the true LCP element from the template before forming a hypothesis. Generated files (colors.css, fontFamilies.css) are overwritten by build:design, so hand edits are lost.

attributes.commands: npm start (Tailwind watch + 11ty serve), npm run build, npm run quick (skips Figma sync), npm run build:design (Figma tokens → CSS), npm run validate, npm run scaffold:component
attributes.rationale: build:design syncs Figma tokens into CSS and must run before build:css, otherwise the CSS build consumes stale token output.

attributes.agents: choreographer (motion/GSAP/ScrollTrigger/reduced-motion), implementer (code changes, components, Sanity wiring), mechanic (build failures, 11ty config, tooling), reviewer (pre-merge, diff, contract compliance), planner (sequence multi-step work), taskmaster (embed TODOs for GitHub Issues workflow)

attributes.skills: gsap-core, gsap-timeline (LandingSequence), gsap-scrolltrigger, gsap-plugins, gsap-performance, gsap-utils; gsap-react and gsap-frameworks not used in this project
attributes.rationale: Skills are installed globally at ~/.claude/skills/; load only what the task needs rather than all by default. The choreographer agent selects the right skill automatically.

attributes.tiers: opus for choreography/motion implementation and page-level planning; sonnet for template/component implementation and Sanity wiring; haiku for copy tweaks, sidecar docs, formatting
attributes.rationale: Motion timing and LCP judgment need the strongest model; mechanical doc/format work does not.
Always emit/listen via AnimationBus — never call sections directly, so cross-section coordination stays event-driven.
